name: Hiiragi Runa
source:
Runa loves causing mischief around the school, sometimes telling lies to her fellow Lacrosse Team member [url=/c98387]Qoo[/url]. She prefers freedom to being restricted. Runa is watching over [url=/c98228]Chiaki[/url] as the latter grows out of her inside-the-box way of thinking. 

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
